verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents running code-based and LLM-as-a-judge evaluations on production traces, not just datasets (docs-61, docs-75), scoring traces and spans (docs-39), with Python/TypeScript SDKs that run evaluations against Phoenix traces (docs-76). The evidence does not show automatic, continuous scoring of incoming live traffic: the no-code UI evaluators attach to datasets and experiments (docs-18), so production scoring appears to be SDK-driven batch runs. Missing for 10: documented continuous/online evaluators that automatically score new production traces as they arrive, sampling or scheduling controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.
